scope: Disposable QEMU UTM-compatible ARM64 disks; not physical UTM or Pi hardware
results: Root directory growth on 128 MiB and 1 GiB copies; six new files and existing Hello.TXT survive cold reboot.
Nested directory growth and existing/new file contents survive cold reboot.
Abrupt guest termination during an active growth journal, boot recovery, subsequent installer upgrade and another reboot preserve existing files on both sizes.
Host-injected torn writes at four installed boot and two installer recovery points on 1 GiB copies; Hello.TXT survives.
Host ownership, shared-journal interruption, and UTM admission checks passed; repeat upgrades passed on both disk sizes.
limitations: Pi directory growth and its SD recovery path remain unsupported.
One long combined test session hit an allocator compiler-checkpoint error; isolated root growth passed, cause not established.
Actual UTM UI and physical power-loss behavior were not tested in this run.
